subject: octagonal room
fact: The octagonal room contains a milky red light, swirling mist obscuring the polished gray floor shot through with glittering mica.
source_quote: The chamber glowed with an unnatural milky red light, swirling mist obscuring the polished gray floor shot through with glittering mica.

subject: processional hallway
fact: The processional hallway is painted with scenes of gross evil, death, and destruction.
source_quote: The party made their way through a processional hallway painted with scenes of gross evil, death, and destruction.

subject: bronze doors
fact: The bronze doors are lined along the southern walls, their polished surfaces carved with vile scenes and runes.
source_quote: Bronze doors lined the southern walls, their polished surfaces carved with vile scenes and runes.

subject: room with white marble floor
fact: The room has a white marble floor, walls and vaulted ceiling sheathed in pearly alabaster, creating a right feel—a place of safety in a storm of evil.
source_quote: The floor was white marble, the walls and vaulted ceiling sheathed in pearly alabaster, creating a right feel—a place of safety in a storm of evil.

subject: cloudy crystal substance
fact: A sheet of cloudy crystal substance is set into the northern portion of the east wall, brightening and radiating light.
source_quote: a sheet of cloudy crystal substance set into the northern portion of the east wall began to brighten, its radiance lighting the chamber.

subject: winged creatures
fact: Two man-like creatures with wings of snowy feathers and radiant faces appear amidst glowing, cloud-tinted billows, robed in purest white with a pale blue sky visible between them.
source_quote: Two man-like creatures with wings of snowy feathers and radiant faces appeared amidst glowing, cloud-tinted billows, robed in purest white with a pale blue sky visible between them.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr offered only his short sword when pressured to surrender weapons.
source_quote: Zephyr offered only his short sword

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia gave a single dagger when pressured to surrender weapons.
source_quote: Zinnia gave a single dagger

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa reluctantly parted with one dagger when pressured to surrender weapons.
source_quote: Sequioa reluctantly parted with one dagger as well.

subject: secret entrance
fact: The secret entrance opens into a bare room permeated by a feral odor, with nesting heaps of cloth and pillows, bones and litter covering the floor, and rust-red cloaks hanging on pegs.
source_quote: Opening it discreetly, they discovered a bare room permeated by a feral odor, with nesting heaps of cloth and pillows, bones and litter covering the floor, and rust-red cloaks hanging on pegs.

subject: werewolves
fact: Two werewolves snarl at the intruders, their eyes gleaming with predatory intelligence; one laughs darkly, saying this could have been much easier if they had dropped all their weapons and come in unarmed.
source_quote: Inside were two werewolves who snarled at the intruders, their eyes gleaming with predatory intelligence. One of them laughed darkly, saying this could have been much easier if they had just dropped all their weapons and come in unarmed—they supposed they would have to do it the hard way for the Fire Temple.

subject: silver service
fact: A silver service worth a considerable sum is discovered and divided among the party.
source_quote: they discovered a silver service worth a considerable sum, which they divided among themselves.

subject: magical dagger
fact: A magical dagger is found and distributed to a party member lacking an enchanted weapon.
source_quote: they found a magical dagger and short sword, which they distributed to those who still lacked enchanted weapons.

subject: magical short sword
fact: A magical short sword is found and distributed to a party member lacking an enchanted weapon.
source_quote: they found a magical dagger and short sword, which they distributed to those who still lacked enchanted weapons.

subject: loose flagstone
fact: A loose flagstone conceals a hidden treasure pile beneath it.
source_quote: a loose flagstone that concealed a hidden treasure pile.

subject: silver pieces
fact: Silver pieces are found beneath the loose flagstone.
source_quote: Beneath it lay silver pieces

subject: holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao
fact: Holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao are found beneath the loose flagstone.
source_quote: holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao

subject: five silver daggers
fact: Five silver daggers are found beneath the loose flagstone.
source_quote: five silver daggers

subject: nineteen silver-tipped arrows
fact: Nineteen silver-tipped arrows are found beneath the loose flagstone.
source_quote: nineteen silver-tipped arrows

subject: bone-covered hallway
fact: The bone-covered hallway contains skeletal warriors lying in wait to animate.
source_quote: moving silently through the bone-covered hallway where skeletal warriors lay waiting to animate.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer boldly claims to be a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who converted to the Earth Temple’s cause.
source_quote: Calmer boldly claimed to be a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who had converted to the Earth Temple’s cause.

subject: plush guest chamber
fact: The plush guest chamber is now dirty and cluttered.
source_quote: entered a chamber that had once been a plush guest chamber but was now dirty and cluttered.

subject: ogre
fact: An ogre is slain, but its body reveals it is a member of the Earth Temple, not the Fire Temple.
source_quote: the ogre was a member of the Earth Temple, not the Fire Temple.

subject: Lieutenant Krell
fact: Lieutenant Krell is revealed as a spy who set up the party to kill an Earth Temple ogre.
source_quote: the most likely culprit was Lieutenant Krell himself.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag declares he knew Lieutenant Krell was a spy and commands the party to bring him alive for sacrifice in the Temple of Earth.
source_quote: Romag listened to their account, and his rage became palpable as he declared he had known the lieutenant was a spy and had kept him under watch. With fury burning in his eyes, Romag commanded the party to bring the traitor to him alive so he could sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth as a warning to all who would dare betray them.

subject: badges of the Earth Temple
fact: Romag hands the party badges of the Earth Temple, declaring they have proven their worth.
source_quote: He handed them badges of the Earth Temple, declaring they had proven their worth and would have a place among his followers.

subject: bunk rooms
fact: The party rests in the bunk rooms with the other guards.
source_quote: That night, the party rested in the bunk rooms with the other guards

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch admitted that Alremm had hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch, who admitted that Alremm had hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits.

subject: Alremm
fact: Alremm hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits.
source_quote: Alremm had hired werewolves in the secret chamber as a test of the new recruits.

subject: Temple of Earth
fact: Romag commands the party to bring Lieutenant Krell alive to sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth.
source_quote: Romag commanded the party to bring the traitor to him alive so he could sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth as a warning to all who would dare betray them.
